claims.statement: The component exposes its documented public behavior through a stable versioned entrypoint.
A row inside a swipe-enabled drawer claims the inline axis without disabling the drawer's own gesture.
Reveal runs opposite the drawer's dismiss direction in every handedness and writing-direction combination.
Every swipe action is also reachable without the gesture, through the consuming surface's menu.
While its actions are showing the row publishes a claim on the inline axis, so putting them away never also dismisses the drawer behind them.

component.purpose: Accelerates one or two frequent row actions with a drag, without becoming the only route to them.
component.title: Swipe actions

states.description: Reveal mirrored for an end-anchored drawer.
